meta.title: Giveaway Winners — Free Game Giveaways on Discord
meta.description: Every winner of the Gamer's Exile Discord giveaways: free games, in-game currency and gear for active members. Free to enter, never pay-to-win — join the gaming Discord to enter the next one.

header.title: Free Giveaways. Real Winners.
header.lead: Games, in-game currency and gear, given away to the people who make the server what it is. Every past winner is listed here — no purchase, no paid entries, ever.

steps.title: Join the Discord
steps.body: Giveaways are announced in the server first, with the prize, the closing time and how to enter.

steps.title: Enter for free
steps.body: React to the giveaway post. Some draws are for active members — entry comes from taking part, never from paying.

steps.title: Winners are drawn
steps.body: A bot picks at random when the giveaway closes, in public, in the same channel.

steps.title: Claim your prize
steps.body: A moderator messages the winner on Discord. Unclaimed prizes are re-drawn.

timeline.title: Past Giveaways
timeline.footer: Every winner keeps a permanent spot on this page.

empty.title: The First Winners Will Be Listed Here
empty.body: Our first giveaways are being prepared. When a prize is drawn, the winner gets a permanent spot on this page.
empty.cta: Join the Discord to enter the next giveaway

items.q: How do I enter a giveaway?
items.a: Join the Gamer's Exile Discord and watch the giveaways channel. Each post says what's up for grabs, when it closes and how to enter — usually a single reaction.
Yes. Membership is free and giveaways are free to enter. There are no paid entries, no paid roles and nothing pay-to-win — the same rule that applies to everything in the server.
Randomly, by a giveaway bot, the moment the giveaway closes and in public view. Some giveaways are reserved for active members, and accounts made just to farm entries are disqualified.

A moderator contacts the winner by Discord DM to arrange delivery — usually a game key, gift card code or in-game gift. We never ask for passwords or payment. If a prize isn't claimed within the stated time, it's re-drawn.

cta.heading: The Next Prize Could Be Yours
cta.lead: Join the Discord, turn on giveaway pings, and take part. Entry is free — it always will be.
